service.initialize: initialize_search_index(db) after source DDL inside init_db BEGIN IMMEDIATE, before commit
service.maintenance: rebuild_search_index(db) inside db_transaction(); preserves caller transaction through SAVEPOINT
service.search: search_content(db, user, query, limit=20, *, offset=0, issue_id=None, types=None, since=None) -> page

rest.auth: Current cookie session, get_current_user; service rechecks active identity

parameters.query: Literal AND terms, double-quoted phrases, trailing word* prefixes; max 1000 Unicode characters and 32 terms/phrases
parameters.issue_id: Optional positive SQLite integer ID; unknown ID yields an empty filtered page
parameters.types: Repeated query parameters types=issue&types=update; omitted means both; unknown values rejected
parameters.since: Optional inclusive ISO8601 lower bound with explicit timezone, e.g. 2026-10-19T16:00:00+02:00

items.update_id: Update ID or null for Issue hits
items.title: Current parent Issue title, max 240 characters
items.user_id: Source author ID or null after user deletion
items.user: Current username, max 160 characters, or null
items.snippet: Plain excerpt <=322 visible characters including ellipses
items.snippet_html: HTML-escaped excerpt with only server-generated <mark> highlights

page.total: Filtered total from the same read snapshot

semantics.visibility: All active users, including active MCP identities, see the same corpus. require_active_user checks current activity and supplied mcp_token_id including revocation and Kill-Switch before any early return. No edit permission required.
semantics.time: since uses updated_at of both source types, not created_at. Source timestamps are UTC with second resolution; fractional lower bounds round upwards to the next source second. Non-content Issue changes that change updated_at also affect since. Search is not a change feed.
semantics.unicode: FTS5 unicode61 remove_diacritics 2, case-insensitive, with NFC input normalization. No stemming or arbitrary infix matching.
semantics.ranking: One shared BM25 corpus with equal title/body weights, ascending BM25 then updated_at descending, type ascending, source ID descending. Raw scores are not exposed.
semantics.query_syntax: Whitespace/punctuation separate ordinary words combined with AND. Double quotes specify an ordered phrase. A final * expands the final word prefix. Uppercase AND/OR/NOT are literal search terms. FTS control syntax is rejected.
semantics.empty: Empty/whitespace query and an explicitly empty types list return an empty page after current-identity and filter validation.
semantics.snapshot: Identity, total, and items share one SQLite read snapshot. Pagination across separate requests may change after concurrent writes.
semantics.snippet_security: Random per-query FTS markers; source characters HTML-escaped; no stored HTML passed through. Plain excerpts are suitable for textContent.

index.rowid: Positive Issue ID; negative Update ID, avoiding multiplication overflow or type collisions
index.synchronization: Insert/content-update/delete triggers run in the source transaction. Issue deletion cascades Update deletions and their index triggers. Metadata is joined from authoritative current source rows.
index.backfill: Installation and missing-trigger repair rebuild from authoritative sources atomically. Failure rolls back derived schema changes; source rows are untouched. Existing matching version is retained.
index.dependency: SQLite FTS5/unicode61 required; startup explicitly fails if unavailable, without LIKE fallback.

verification.scope: 15 tests: real content matching/ranking/snippets, current users/tokens, REST/service parity, filters/time/pagination, source triggers/cascades, atomic backfill/rollback, restart/idempotency, FTS failure behavior
verification.mcp: Root #396 integrates and tests actual MCP transport using the same service.
